operationContracts.effect: Capability CNt plus personal-account guard; GET/PATCH /notifications/settings with ChatGPT-Account-ID and per-user/account query key. Parameterized categories/channels, teen_safety contact eligibility and tasks manage-link delegation are distinct conditions.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Latest per-account/category/channel mutation owns optimistic cache/rollback; stale success ignored but stale nonaborted error still toasts. Abort suppresses rollback/toast; cleanup invalidates without refetch then aborts tracked requests. Account/user guard rechecked before mutation; contact channels rechecked before update.

mechanisms.name: Per-variant theme write coordination
mechanisms.claim: pendingWriteCount/snapshot, per-variant themeWriteQueue continued after rejection, paired write compensation, partial-write flag, pending snapshot cleanup, edit/accent revisions and conditional account synchronization.
mechanisms.qualification: Host persistence, parser/normalizer, query finalizer and rendering adapters remain separate.

mechanisms.name: Account notification optimistic concurrency and cancellation
mechanisms.claim: Per channel mutation key/id with optimistic update, latest result ownership, guarded rollback and tracked AbortControllers; cleanup invalidation has refetchType:none.
mechanisms.qualification: Actual HTTP service, authentication, query lifecycle and server cancellation are not proven by synthetic callbacks.

modeDecision.accountNotificationCandidate: ct/Ye manages explicit ChatGPT account notification channels, with capability/personal-account guards, but selected product mode and complete shared-consumer closure remain unproven.
modeDecision.doNotDeleteWholeModule: General imports a/i/t/r from the same notifications chunk; lt/Ve supplies desktop task alerts and sound. Appearance contains shared theme and account-accent branches. Module-level names/labels do not justify removal.

dependencyBoundary.qualification: Existing dependency-import-decisions and embedded investigations remain package/version authority; chunk names and aliases do not establish package identity or exact versions.
